valores.label: from U.S. possession of the canal works

fonte: Panama Canal Treaty, 1977 (United Nations Treaty Series, vol. 1280, I-21086)
nota: Relido: ICC 1905, "since the United States took possession of the canal properties on May 4" (1904); UNTS, 01/10/1979; Art. XI(1) "reassume plenary jurisdiction over the former Canal Zone"; FAM "ceased to exist on that date". 75 anos é conta nossa (04/05/1904 → 01/10/1979 = 75 anos e quase 5 meses; o dossiê grava "75 anos e 4 meses (27.543 dias)" — os meses completos são 4, quase 5). Qualquer marco dá 75, nunca 76.
